desc: Ignores builds, node_modules, Rust target, machine-local Claude/Codex files, demo data and sift's local/
GNU GPL v3 licence text
Build, check (lint+test), fmt, install-app, dmg, icons and screenshots targets
Short project README: what Tidemark is, the website, install steps, docs index, GPL licence
Docs: each screen briefly with its screenshot, the Settings table, menu bar, Ask, how charts read
The user guide, also the app's help drawer; one copy of the help text
Vite entry HTML for the app window and the tray window
npm manifest: version, GPL licence, scripts (dev, build, lint, tauri) and React/Tauri dependencies
Template for signing.local (untracked): the local code-signing identity Make uses so Full Disk Access survives rebuilds
Rust manifest: tauri, sysinfo, rusqlite, plist, objc2 for macOS; GPL-3.0-or-later; fast release profile
Tauri build script entry point (tauri_build::build())
Tauri capability grant for the main window: window controls, dialog and clipboard permissions
macOS app icon bundle (.icns), generated by tools/make_icons.py
Ask: runs the Claude Code CLI in print mode with no tools, streams its answer as ask-chunk/ask-done events, tracks and kills its processes
Antigravity CLI with a per-run agent listing no tools: streams deltas, models from agy models
Claude Code in print mode with --tools "": streams text deltas, resumes by session id
Codex exec --json in the read-only sandbox: models from its cache, answer sent whole at the end
GitHub Copilot CLI with only the view tool in an empty folder: streams deltas, auto model only
Ask backend: shared prompt, CLI status and models, process tracking, dispatch to the four CLI drivers
The last scan of each root, kept so the next launch can draw it at once while a fresh scan
Tauri command get_files: lists a folder's direct files (not subdirs) with size, on-disk size, mtime and kind, without following symlinks
SQLite history: schema and migrations, minute readings, incidents, crashes, sleeps, disk totals, pruning
Tauri setup: modules, command registration, menus (About with website link, Help), windows, tray, recorder start
Binary entry point: sets the macOS process name pre-AppKit-start, then hands off to the lib's run()
Sampler: CPU/GPU/memory/disk/network/energy readings, per-app use, incidents, status severity, tidemarks, perf brief
The scan: a parallel walk of one folder tree that produces a tree of folder sizes.
Disk history upkeep: hourly used-space sample, scheduled full scans (daily when idle on power, hourly, off), pruning
The volume a path lives on: its name, capacity and free space.
Tauri config: version, bundle id, windows (main and tray), icons, macOS 13 minimum, private API
App shell: sidebar and screens, navigation and shortcuts, disk scan state, Ask context and seeds, Help drawer
Ask panel: chat over the map with suggested questions, model picker, streaming answers rendered from Markdown; follow-ups resume the CLI session
React component: sortable, searchable table of a folder's direct files, double-click to reveal in Finder
Help drawer: the guide for the screen on show, searchable; its foot hands a question to Ask
Now screen: status sentence, eight measure cards, the week's tidemarks with Ask buttons, what grew, Ask chips

Recent screen (route 'performance'): every measure over 1 h to 14 days, a tab each with a chart per part, peak bands, moment snapshot with busiest apps, incidents, crashes, Energy's battery and sleep panels, flagged-chart Ask
Settings screen: helper, Open at Login, history days, scan schedule, appearance, About with Website, foot
The app's tooltip for every element with a title: measured, placed below/above/beside, clamped to the window; title moved to data-tip so the native one never shows
Menu-bar window: live readings with sparks, top apps, attention line, actions; exports the Switch control
Disk Map treemap: squarified nested blocks, growth outlines and tags, zoom and hover

Trends screen: every measure a day at a time over 30 days, 3 months or 12 months, tabs like Recent, the picked day's figures and apps, records, by-hour shading from the last 14 days, disk fill projection and folders that rose
Typed wrappers over every Tauri command the UI calls
Which AI CLIs are installed and their models, grouped by provider; why Ask is disabled; the remembered model
SVG charts: Area with peak band, tidemark, gaps and hover readout; Spark; Heatmap; Legend
describeView: the folder on screen and its biggest folders as text for Ask's first message
The help's text: docs/guide.md imported at build time, split by ## into sections, searched, and rendered from Markdown with tables and links
/ How long the splash stays up at minimum, so a fast start reads as a deliberate opening
Minimal Markdown to HTML for Ask answers: headings, lists, fenced and inline code, bold, italics; escaped first
Shared hooks and helpers: live readings, timed polling, now/startOfToday, gaps and up-to-now series
Recent's tabs: their ids, labels and icons, and which tab a Details link's target opens
Every style: theme tokens (tide colours, light/dark), layout, cards, charts, map, tray, Ask and Help
Types shared with the backend: scan, live readings, status, perf minutes, incidents, crashes, settings
/ Decimal units, as macOS reports them. Three significant figures at most.
Draw the app's artwork: design/icon.png (the Dock icon source) and src-tauri/icons/tray@2x.png.
Recapture docs/screenshots/app.png from the installed app, at a fixed window size so the README
